items.title: STAT+：買藥品專利申請案，是不是想延長市場獨佔期？
items.summary: 一宗涉及安進（Amgen）的藥品專利案備受關注，因為它可能對整個製藥業的專利交易產生廣泛影響。

items.title: 美國食藥局（FDA） OKs Takeda, Protagonist drug for rare blood cancer
items.summary: The clearance and broader-than-expected label for Mimrylo open up a yearly revenue opportunity for Takeda that some analysts expect to reach $2 billion or more.

items.title: Lilly adds to immune drug pipeline with $2.9B Merida buyout
items.summary: The big drugmaker’s latest company acquisition this year is centered around a technology designed to degrade proteins that malfunction in autoimmune disorders.

items.title: STAT+: In autopsy of failed heart disease study, AstraZeneca raises broader questions about silencer drugs
items.summary: AstraZeneca detailed the surprise failure of a closely watched heart disease trial, a study with ripple effects for a competitive billion-dollar market.

items.title: Vaccines take center stage at federal autism advisory committee
items.summary: Comments about vaccines overshadowed an advisory committee meeting to discuss a plan for boosting federal funding for autism research.

items.title: Moderna raises $2.6B to support cancer work; 美國食藥局（FDA） clears updated COVID vaccines
items.summary: Moderna’s upsized note offering quickly followed a big win in a crucial study. Elsewhere, a biotech’s shares tumbled after study data were “inadvertently” published ahead of a medical meeting.

items.title: This week in charts: Biotech’s rebound is undeniable
items.summary: Not only is the XBI continuing to hover around a historic high, but drug companies can’t seem to get enough of both large IPOs and big-ticket M&A.
